body_markdown:
On 23 September, BW LPG Chief Financial Officer Samantha Xu took the stage at the 25th Annual Marine Money Week Asia in Singapore for a fireside chat titled, “Delivering Energy for a Better World: How Smart Financing Powers the World’s Largest LPG Fleet.”


In conversation with Kheng Sin Chu, Managing Director and Regional Head of Transportation Finance at Standard Chartered, Samantha shared how disciplined capital allocation supports BW LPG’s fleet renewal, growth and resilience through the shipping cycle.


*BW LPG CFO Samantha Xu in conversation with Kheng Sin Chu of Standard Chartered at Marine Money Week Asia 2026.*


The discussion explored the importance of pursuing growth based on long-term value rather than simply the availability of capital. Samantha spoke about how this principle guides BW LPG’s decisions across vessel acquisitions, fleet renewal and capital returns, helping the company remain competitive and financially resilient as market conditions change.


She also reflected on BW LPG’s evolving approach to financing. From traditional bank financing and India’s GIFT City to the convertible bond market, the company continues to assess different financing tools with the aim of optimising its balance sheet, reducing cash breakeven and maintaining flexibility.


Another key theme was the importance of strong financing partnerships. Samantha acknowledged the banking partners who have supported BW LPG across its corporate financing and debt and equity capital market transactions, contributing ideas, market access and execution capabilities.


BW LPG’s India GIFT City financing was also recognised with Marine Money’s 2025 Bank Debt East Deal of the Year award. The transaction demonstrates how thoughtful financing can support business priorities while improving the economics of the company’s capital structure.


As Samantha highlighted during the conversation, smart financing is not about raising more capital. It is about deploying capital with discipline and choosing the right financing at the right time.


BW LPG thanks Marine Money for inviting us to be part of its 25th anniversary conference and for recognising our India GIFT City financing. We also thank Kheng Sin Chu and Standard Chartered for the engaging conversation, and our financing partners for their continued collaboration and support.
